name: Positionstack
tagline: Forward and reverse geocoding API for address and coordinates lookup
description: Positionstack provides a REST geocoding API for converting addresses to coordinates and coordinates to addresses, with batch and multi-language support for location-based apps.

auth.details: API key via access_key query parameter; self-serve signup

example.response_snippet: {"data":[{"latitude":38.897675,"longitude":-77.036547,"label":"1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC, USA"}]}

use_cases: geocode a street address to latitude/longitude
reverse geocode coordinates to a formatted address
